summary: Reduced wingtip clearance on taxiways B, C and E at EGVN for aircraft with wingspan of 60 m or more.
text:
CAUTION TWY B: FENCES OPPOSITE BAYS 70 AND 73-74 REDUCE
WINGTIP CLEARANCE FOR AIRCRAFT WITH WINGSPAN 60M OR GREATER.
CAUTION TWY C: AERIAL OPPOSITE C1 HOLD REDUCES WINGTIP
CLEARANCE FOR AIRCRAFT WITH WINGSPAN 60M OR GREATER. 
CAUTION TWY E: FENCE NORTH OF TWY J AND BUILDING REDUCE
WINGTIP CLEARANCE FOR AIRCRAFT WITH WINGSPAN 60M OR GREATER. 
PILOTS UNWILLING TO ACCEPT REDUCED CLEARANCE ARE TO INFORM 
ATC BEFORE ARRIVAL. THESE TAXIWAYS ARE NOT ROUTINELY USED BY 
AIRCRAFT WITH WINGSPAN 64M OR GREATER AND USE IS AT CAPTAIN'S
DISCRETION. OBSTACLES MAY EXIST 47.5M TO 57.5M FROM ALL TWY 
CENTRELINES.
